The Alignment Breakthrough

Alignment is the key to humanity's future with AGI. By bridging artificial intelligence with human values, we create a foundation for unprecedented progress while amplifying human agency and purpose.

The Alignment Breakthrough

Books One and Two present a revolutionary framework for aligning superintelligent systems with human values, ensuring technology serves humanity's highest aspirations.

This book serves as your guide into this uncharted territory, a map through the complex landscape of the post-AGI world.

We will explore the philosophical dilemmas AGI presents, grapple with the economic transformations it may trigger, and explore the potential societal structures that could emerge.

Forget the dystopian visions of robot overlords or the utopian dreams of effortless abundance.

This book is about understanding the real challenges and opportunities AGI offers, and most importantly, how we, as humans, can actively shape this future.
